newsitem.title: USA: Baxter sets dividend in Allegiance spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Baxter sets dividend in Allegiance spinoff.

text.p: Baxter International Inc said on Monday that its shareholders will receive one share of health care products unit Allegiance Corp for each five shares of Baxter stock under a spinoff unveiled by the company last year.
Baxter will not retain any shares of Allegiance after the special, in-kind dividend is paid to Baxter shareholders.

Allegiance was formed in June as a wholly owned subsidiary of Baxter. The company includes Baxter's U.S. hospital supply distribution business, surgical and respiratory therapy products manufacturing and health care cost management services operations, Baxter said.

Baxter expects the dividend to be effective on September 30 to shareholders of record on September 26. The distribution is subject to completion of a registration process by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the company said.
